findings.message: 7 node(s) were still alive outside the tree after the scene was freed. A node that is `Node.new()`d and never added to the tree, or `remove_child()`ed and never freed, leaks until the process exits. Add it to the tree, or free it with queue_free()/free().

claim_boundary: No clean-shutdown, general save authenticity or human fun/pacing claim; ordinary50 complete journey is RLY8.
